origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
Lfayda n wemdan yeldi akteṛ n aṭas n yemdanen, ur d-yețțak ara lfayda d lecɣal..
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Ur d-yețwaḥess ara amkan n tabṛaț§r
§o§2+ Tazmert imezwura§r
§o§6• Karnivore§r
§o§c- Ur yețwaxelqen ara§r
§lAlfiq§r iberdan-nsen aṭas n wannect-agi i d-yețțawin ɣer ṣṣifa n lǧiha n lmeṣnuɛat..
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Araqnaye
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Tnefsit, Tazmert n leǧwahi n lɣaci
+ Dimmut iḍaṛṛen§r
§o§6• Karnivore§r
§o§c- Laẓ, lḥaǧa§r
?ef wannect-agi i d-yețțaken ṭṭmeɛ akk-d wemdan, s leḥṛam d iḍaṛṛen nniḍen tezmert a t-tebɛen lḥeqq iwakken ad sɛun lḥeqq..
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banshee
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Refli, ḥekkmen, nnejmaɛen§r
§o§6• ulac lmegtin
§o§c- Ur yețwaxelqen ara§r
§o§c- Beddleɣ aṭas, aɣṛet uqbel!§r
§lBanshee§r d iṛuḥaniyen i d-yețwaḥesben iwakken ad iɛeggeḍ tissit, ad sseǧhed imdanen ɣer leɛqel, s lexbaṛ n lmut i d-ițwassen..
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Inbus
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Imezwura n ddnubat n ddnubat
§o§6• Times i gesseǧhed
§o§c- Aman i d-iḍuṛṛen§r
§o§c- Di lǧiha n ddunit§r
§lInkubi§r d iqeddacen n tezmert n ṭṭlam, ț-țazmert di lḥekma-nsen, lameɛna d imezwura i sen-yefkan ṛṛuḥ-nsen, ur ɛeǧben ara i wemdan n ṣṣeḥ..
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ ?ețɛețțib d ṭṭmeɛ§r
§o§6• Kuqt: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- yefṛeḥ amat 
- Ur yezmir ara ad ssufuɣ§r
§lLɣellat§r d ayen yelhan, d zzux akk-d zzux, ḥemmlen ad qqimen di lqaɛa, meɛna ad ḥesben d wass. Ay atmaten, adɣaɣ d azṛu..
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Ilf
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Leḥsab n tuɣam, Tifsit§r
§o§6• ?eqqṛet, nnejmaɛen§r
§o§c- Ur yețwaxelqen ara§r
§lIlif n tegzirt§r d iɛdawen-nsen i gzedɣen di ddunit, țɛeggiḍen s ujenwi, țɛebbiden, țɛeggiḍen iɛdawen-nsen m'ara ɛeddan ttejṛa..
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Elf ɛlayen
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Sebbaɛi, leɛqel ur nesɛi d ameqqran§r
§o§c- Aḍu n tikli
- Ur yețwaxelqen ara§r
§lIlaqen ɛlayen§r d izuxxan-nsen i gḥekkmen s wul yeṣfan ; d idammen-nsen i gxeddmen s lexbaṛ n lxiṛ ; ɣas akken ur nesɛi ara lmeṣnuɛat s llebsa..
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Asan
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ ?ef wannect-agi, ad ḥemmlen, ad țwaḥeqṛen§r
§o§6• Kuqt: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- ?emm'ara ḥemmlen s lḥaǧa§r
§lAsan§r d imuḍan n tejmaɛt i d-yețțaken s lexbaṛ n lxiṛ, țțawin-d s lexbaṛ n lxiṛ i gxeddmen lxiṛ, i gḥemmlen akk-d lɛeṛqen i geẓẓuɣen..
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Uḥebs n ddheb n ddheb§r
§o§2+ ?eǧǧa, Feṛḥ§r 
§o§6• Ciṭṭuḥ: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Leḥṛam d ṣṣifa§r
§lGoblins§r ddheb akk-d ugerruj, ad ufin kra n wussan anda țmuqulen, lameɛna tameqqrant-nsen ur ten-ițțaǧa ara deg umenɣi-nsen..
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Leḥṛam n lexṣaṣ, imdanen§r
§o§2+ Tazmert n lɣaci§r
§o§c- Hydrofobe 
- Neǧhed ameqqran§r
§lunit-format§r ițțuceggeɛ lxuluq i d-yusan d imdanen nniḍen ; s yigengen iɛeqqayen, s leḥṛam-nsen i d-yețțaken, qqaṛen-d iwakken ad sseǧhed wid i d-ițcehden..
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Agur elf
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Axaṭer deg-s
+ Imezdaɣ n Sidi Ṛebbi§r
§o§6• ?eqqṛet, ur yemmut ara§r
§o§c- Ur yețwaxelqen ara§r
Llant n wegdud mačči n ddunit-agi, mačči d aɣṛum i d-ițțusemman seg wexxam-nsen, meɛna d ayen kan i d-ițwassen i wid i d-ițwassen uqbel ad țwalin..
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ogre
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Axaṭer ḥesben n ṣṣifa n lǧameɛ §r
§o§6• Amin: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Laẓ akk-d Leɛtab §r
§lImiren kan§r ț-țideț, d leɛqel i gɛeddan di teswiɛt n temdint n Urc ; s tezmert-nsen yesɛan tazmert akk-d lefhama-nsen i gxeddmen lefhama..
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Refli d ameqqran, tameqqrant§r
§o§6• Tazegt: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Tasa-s, ssufɣen awal §r
Aṭas n yemdanen ḥesben iman-nsen d wid ixeddmen lxiṛ, meɛna ula d wid ur nesɛi lḥeqq, wid ur nesɛi azal ; leḥṛam ț-țmecṭuḥt ț-țamecṭuḥt..
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ ?eqqṛet §r
§o§6• Eɛzizen ur nezmir ara ad ccetki §r
§o§6• ulac lmegtin §r
§o§c- Tasa-s, ssufɣen awal 
§o§c- Di leɛtab§r
Lǧețțat-nni ur nezmir ara ad qqaṛen yemdanen, ad țțuɛellem yerna ad țwaḥesben di lmeḥnat n dayem, imi d leɛtab i d-yețțaken s tezmert tameqqrant..
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Iɛeǧǧben
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Imezwura §r
§o§2+ Iɛewdiwen n weɛṛeq 
§o§6• Ur yemmut ara, ur nețmețțat ara §r
§o§c- Addaf n tneflit
- eɛzizen tudert §r
§lImezdaɣ n Sidi Ṛebbi§r d imdanen ur nesɛi lmuqedmin ur nesɛi lmut ur nesɛi lmeɛna, lameɛna ț-țideț uɣalen ɣer tudert. S wakka nutni țqellibent ad sɛun tudert akk-d lmut deg lekmal nniḍen..
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Simeren
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Ifecka n waman, ifeṛṛeḥ §r
§o§6• Di rrif n lqaɛa§r
§o§c- Tmes ur nesɛi lmeɛna§r
§lSimenyen§r teqqaṛ-iten : d aṭas n lbabuṛ ur nesɛi lmeɛna, ț-țideț, țwaḥesbent-nsen d aṭas n lbabuṛ ur nesɛi lmeɛna..
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Titi
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Imezdaɣ n ddnub,§r
§o§6• Tudert: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- ?effur§r
Lxuluq yesɛan lqayen i d-yețțaken si lɛeṛqen ; tagelda n lebḥeṛ n Tuti yețțaǧa-ten ad feṛqen iɛdawen, lameɛna ț-țaǧǧaǧan-ten aṭas iwakken ad țwaḥeyceggɛen times..
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nAfaf§r: 
§o§2+ Afeḥlun§r 
§o§6• Iɛewdiwen-nsen ɣlinen§r 
§o§c- ?erret iman-nwen d immuten§r
§lValkyrie§r iɛeskeṛ-nsen ur țqelliben ara ɣef wayen yedṛan wid i gețmenɛen deg umenɣi ; qqaṛen : wwin-ten lmegtin ɣer Valhalla n Odin.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Iɛewdiwen
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq yesɛan ṭṭmeɛ n ssufɣen, țțaggaden-d lexṣaṣ s iḍaṛṛen ur nesɛi lfayda, zemren ad ṭṭfen ɣer lebḥeṛ ( ilaq ad țțubecciṛen)
Armi qṛib ad yili yiṭij akk-d yiṭij, Alfiq ad ṛuḥen ad ḥekkmen deg-s.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Ma yella tețmuquleḍ ɣer lqaɛa, ur țțaggadet ara cceṛ seg wass-nni.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Ccix-ed tayeffust ɣer taddart n taddart iwakken aț-țkecmeḍ kra n ssufɣen nniḍen, neɣ aț-țețwaṭṭef amkan. Amek ara tezmirem aț-țkecmem i imukan nniḍen.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Puzzle
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: M'ara ɛeddi kra n wussan, yiwen n Alfiq yezmer ad iɛeddi ɣer lebɛid ; aɛdaw-nni i d-ițwaxleq deg waman i deg ara d-yefk lḥal.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq yesseɣli-d leḥṛam s lbabuṛ, yesseɣli-d s llebsa n tnefsit am ijenwiyen d iɛekwan.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Alfiq yextaṛ iwakken ad yeslusu anagar leslaḥ ifeṛṛan iwakken ad ițțuɛaqben. Ilaq aț-țețwaɛaqeb s ṭṭmeɛ.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: ?ess
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Araqna yeḥwaǧ aṭas n lqut iwakken ad iqqim tudert.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: Axaṭer tamurt n Arachnay yesɛan leɛqel iwakken ad yesɛu lḥal akteṛ n wuzzal. Ayagi i gzemren ad ițțuɛaqben s ṣṣifa.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Iḍaṛṛen n temdint n Araqnayen yeǧǧa-ten ad ssersen leḥwayeǧ n leswaṛ.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Axaṭer taddart n Askelton n temdint n Araqnaye ț-țaǧǧaǧat iwakken ad xedmen cceṛ ; aṭas n ṣṣifa i gellan akteṛ n wemdan i gesɛan lǧehd.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Tmanya n wallen n temdint n Araqna i d-ițțunefkent akk ɣer ṭṭlam, iwakken ad țwalint ț-țideț s tafat.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Axaṭer tesɛam tsefṛaḥ n lebḥeṛ n Araqnay, mkul ccwal yesɛan tazmert a t-id-yefk ṭṭmeɛ.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Banshew yesɛan tazmert iwakken ad sɛun lǧețțat ur nezmir ara, ad ṛuḥen ɣer wemkan n lǧețța nniḍen ɣas akken ur zmiren ara ad sɛun lǧehd-agi. Ayagi yesɛan tazmert tameqqrant yerna ur izmir ara ad ixeddem ɣas akken llan laẓ.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: ?eqqṛet
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Banshew-nni țwaḥeṛṛun, m'ara sen-newwet, kra n lweqt i deg ara d-ițwaḥesben iwakken ad ițțuɛaqben lmut.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Leḥṛam n ṣṣifa, am nutni neɣ lfeṭṭa, ur nezmir ara a t-ixeddmen.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Banshew ur d-yețțak ara lxuf n lqut. Tazmert-nsen i d-yesseɣlin kan si tafat n waggur, lameɛna ur zmiren ara ad lluẓen.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Lmut n Banshee n lmut n Banshee ; zemren ad ssufɣen imeẓẓuɣen, ad ssufɣen imdanen iǧehden, ad ssiwḍen tameqqrant n ṣṣifa. Lmuqedmin i d-ițwaṛeqen s uḥeqq.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: M'ara tesɛuḍ yiwen wesɣaṛ ițțuɛuḍen, tețțawiḍ aṭas n leḥṛam.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Ur tezmirem ara aț-țḍuɛem cceṛ ɣef yal yiwen weɣṛum ițțuɛuṣan.
Idammen n idammen ur nesɛi lfayda, mačči d lǧețța n leɛqiṛa neɣ d ayen ur nesɛi lfayda.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Inkubi yesɛan tazmert s tmes meṛṛa, tzemreḍ aț-țserreḥ i tmes, aț-țesɛu tazmert s tmes.
Tmes tɛeǧǧben am wexxam, ur d-yețțak ara lexbaṛ i Inkubi iwakken a ten-id-yawi.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Inkubi yekka-d imukan n waman iwakken a ten-yesseḥyu deg waman.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Inkubi yețțawi-d lexṣaṣ n Smith iwakken ad isseḥlu, ad isseḥlu.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Inkubi ur ɛeqli ara lmeṣnuɛat anda yețfeǧǧiǧen yiṭij, dinna ț-țaǧǧaǧan-d, lameɛna ț-țideț iǧehden di temdint n Niṛif.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Imezdaɣ n ddnub yezmer ad ibedd tazmert n tudert-nsen di kra n lweqt.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Taɣect-agi ad yesɛu allen n ddheb, ad iderɣel-iten lweqt i deg ara sen-d-yewɛeṛ, ad isseɣli s tḥebbuṭ neɣ s tmes n ddheb.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Anagar
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Lɣaci ț-țameqqrant ɣef ddemma n ṭṭmeɛ-nsen, țwasseɣlin deg waman.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Leɛmeṛ yezmer ad sɛuɣ adɣaɣ iwakken ad sɛuɣ tazmert s wayes ur sɛiɣ ara lḥaǧa, ayen i yi-d-ițțaǧǧaɣ akteṛ n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Leɛmeṛ ur nesɛi azal n leḥwayeǧ iɛeddayen, ț-țameqqrant am yiwen.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: ?ef wannect-agi, lḥal yezmer a t-teẓri s wayen yelhan mbla ma yeḥwaǧ tafat.
Leɛmeṛ ẓran ɣef ddemma n teswiɛt-nsen yesɛan lǧehd iwakken a d-yawi tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tameqqrant. Sbeddlet iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ leḥnana.
Imdanen ur sɛin ara tbecciṛ si tḥila n lsas.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Iḥewwaten-nsen ḥemmlen ad leɛqel leḥṛam s tekciwin ; ț-țfayda-nsen ț-țamecṭuḥt, ț-țamecṭuḥt-nsen.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: Mazal di leɛṭeṛ neɣ di tegzirt, lḥeṛma n tqeḍɛit ad sɛuɣ iḍ iwakken ad sɛuɣ imensi n wegdud i gzedɣen.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Ɣef wannect-agi, lḥebs-nni i d-ițțunefkent aɛdaw n ddnub m'ur țwaḥesben ara.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: M'ara ɛeddi kra n segundot, seǧǧa-t-id acemma s teswiɛt akk-d lḥeqq iwakken ad ṭṭfeɛ iɛdawen, a d-tɛiwdeḍ s snat.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Lḥebs-agi ur d-tețțawi ara lḥal, ur țɛeṭṭiq ara ad yesɛu llebsa n lɛib ( ițțuɛaqbeḍ s ṭṭmeɛ).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Llant i gzemren ad qqimen deg iger, ur zmiren ara ad ččen lqut.
Llant n ṭṭmeɛ akteṛ n wemdan.
Ṛuḥam-nwen ur tezmirem ara, lameɛna țɛeṭṭiḍen, ṭṭmeɛ-nwen tețwaḍeggṛen, lameɛna ț-țaǧǧaǧat-nwen țɛeṭṭiqen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Di leɛqel
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Leḥṛam d ameqqran, a ten-t-id-teddun s waṭas n lxuluq.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Leḥṛam d ameqqran ; acḥal meqqṛet d ameqqran akteṛ n leɛṭeṛ.
Imezwura d lfeṭṭa țțaggaden tazmert n lexṣaṣ, ur țțaǧǧa ara ad ț-islusun.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Llan d ț-țafat, d lxuluq i gzemren ad ssufuɣ s ṣṣwab ɣer igenni.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Tazmert n tudert tezmert di teswiɛt n tudert i kra n lweqt ; m'ara xedmen lfayda, sbeggneɣ zzerriɛa ɣer zzerriɛa ɣer wexxam n igenwan, ɣer teswiɛt-nni iwakken ad sseḥlun tazmert i yid-sen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Sseǧǧdet tazmert n tudert s wayes ara wen-d-yefk tezmert di tmura i deg ara wen-d-yezzin.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: M'ara telliḍ di ṭṭmeɛ n leḥṛam, aqeṛṛuy-ik tesɛuḍ deg-wen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: aț-țesɛum tazmert, aț-țețțunefk-ikkun a t-tesɛum, aț-țesɛum ṣṣwab, aț-țḍuɛem ɣef ddemma n leɛqel.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Leḥṛam n leḥṛam ur nesɛi lḥal akteṛ n wemdan.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Imezdaɣ n lɛuqal-nsen ț-țaǧǧat, țẓerrin anda ara d-afen aṭas n wiyaḍ ur nesɛi ara lmeɛna.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Aḍu
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Axaṭer ṭṭmeɛ-nsen ur sɛin ara ṣṣifa n ṭṭmeɛ-nsen, ur sɛin ara lḥal yerna ur țțaggaden ara.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: leḥṛam
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Imezdaɣ n temdint n Gobli sɛan gar-asen gar-asen ; m'ara snefhem neɣ msefhamen ddheb.
Ifassen n ddheb i d-yețțaken akteṛ n aṭas n wid ur țqadaṛen ara.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Dimbla
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Ɣas ṭṭmeɛ, imezdaɣ n leɛqel țțuẓummen, țțaǧan-ten ad ṭṭfen iɛdawen iǧehden mbla imenɣi.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: Imezdaɣ n temdint n Goblin ț-țamecṭuḥt, ț-țamecṭuḥt n wemdan.
Ur yezmir ara a d-yefk aman ṣṣfa iwakken a t-id-yexleq.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Iɛebbaṛ-nsen ad qqimen di lḥebs n ṭṭlam akk-d lḥebs iqedsen ; ɣas akken qqimen di beṛṛa, s yimeslayen i d-ițwaḥeṛsen armi d yiḍ.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Ur țțaǧan ara lḥebs iwakken ad sɛun ṣṣfa n lfeṭṭa ; ur zmiren ara ad sɛun lxuf m'ara ț-texleq ; ula d Iṛun țțusemman am lfeṭṭa.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: ?ef wallen-nwen kra n lɣaci i kkun-id-yewwi, uɣalen-d ɣer wedɣaɣ, ur txeddmem ara ɣef iqeddacen n imeqqranen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Iɛdawen-nsen ur nezmir ara ad ssersen ; m'ara sen-yeɣleb iɛdawen-nsen, m'ara ten-id-yesseḥsen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Aql-ikkun țțaǧan deg-s aṭas n leḥṛam.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: Leḥṛam ɛlayen iwumi yesɛan lḥekma ɛlayen iwakken aț-țesɛuḍem s ṣṣifa, ur t-tețțawi ara lḥal.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: M'ara ṭṭfen deg waṭas n waṭas n waṭas n tikli, lfas ɛlayen zemren ad ssersen tazmert n wemdan iwakken a d-serrḥen leɛqel ɣef mkul tiqbucin iwakken ad walin lfayda.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: Ur yebni ara ulawen ɛlayen iwakken ad imenɛen deg ufus ; ur d-tețțawi ara lǧețța-s, ur sɛin ara lḥal.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: Iɛeskeṛ ɛlayen ț-țaǧǧat i gxeddmen tazmert n tezmert n tezmert n tezmert n tezmert-nsen, țțaggaden-d sebba s wayes ara xedmen leɛṛuṛ nniḍen.

power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: Di ṭṭlam, lḥebs n wagguren ur nețwali ara, iwakken aț-țesseɣli m'ara tɛeǧǧiḍ, ad ṛuḥen di leɛmeṛ. M'ara d-teɣli ɣef ṭṭmeɛ, ṭṭmeɛ-nsen tamezwarut tețțawi-d lexṣaṣ yerna tfeṛq-ed ayen ur nețwali ara. Ayagi yețțawi-d cceṛ tameqqrant ma yesɛan ṭṭmeɛ.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Aɣṛum yesɛan lḥebs iwakken aț-țesɛu llebsa n ddnub ; s ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa i gzemren a d-tɛiwdeḍ.
Aɣṛum yesɛan azal d amecṭuḥ akk-d kra n timeqqrant, aṭas-nsen yesɛan lmeṣnuɛat d amecṭuḥ.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Aɣṛum yesɛan ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa, yețțawi-d lexṣaṣ n lǧețța.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: Aɣṛum yesɛan tafat iwakken ad ffren lḥebs, ad xedmen leḥwayeǧ iwakken ad xedmen tiswiɛin akk-d tiswiɛt.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: M'ara d-yefk agur, lḥal yesɛan tazmert a d-yexdem kra n wudmawen.
Aɣṛum ț-țaɛeqqaṛ n wemkan n watmaten-nsen yellan di leǧwahi, iwakken a ten-iserreḥ akteṛ n wemdan.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Aṭas n tiwwura i gellan d ameqqran, ur zmiren ara ad qqimen deg tewwura neɣ deg waṭas n lbenna imeẓyanen.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Ur țḥebbiṛen ara ayen ččan, ayen ččan d lqut, ur țțawin ara lxuf neɣ laẓ.

power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Ɣef wannect-agi, ḥesben iman-nsen ad ṭṭmeɛ ɣer yiderɣalen, anda ara sɛuɣen iɛdawen, lameɛna ur zmiren ara ad xedmen ayen yedṛan zdat-sen.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: Sluski
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: ?uɛeṛqen akteṛ n wid yesɛan tazmert, ad ḥesben kra n tezmert-nsen m'ara ṭṭfen tameqqrant.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Agenger
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Aɣeṭṭas iḍaɛen d iɣsan iḍaṛṛen n ɛulqen zemren-ten aṭas n lqaɛa akteṛ n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Ur zmiren ara lmeṣnuɛat s llebsa n ddheb, ur zmiren ara ad sɛun ifṛax nniḍen iwakken ad ṭṭfen mbla lfayda.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Leḥṛam ț-țafat, ur zmiren ara ad ɣlin cceṛ.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: Di lqaɛa
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Leɛmeṛ zemren ad ṭṭfen ɣer zdat akk-d zdat..
Qṛeb tazmert-agi iwakken a d-yefk lmuqedmin amek ara yeɛɛeddi..
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Aqcic
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Tzemreḍ aț-țeqqimeḍ ɣef uqeṛṛuy n acemmaṛ nniḍen s ifassen yelhan.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: ?-țideț, m'ara xedmen lmeṣnuɛat, a d-awin kra n tikkelt si wedɣaɣ ifazen.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Kra n leḥṛam i gzedɣen lǧețța imeẓyanen n tmurt, ur d-tețțawi ara tigeẓẓum n wemdan.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: ?ef wannect-a
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: Imi țmecṭuḥen, aman yesɛan lǧehd iwakken a d-yesseɣlin leḥwayeǧ ; tḥeqqeq-asen leḥṛam-nsen, tḥeqqeq-iten lemḥayen-nsen ad ssufɣen.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Imezdaɣ n tudrin ẓran lexbaṛ n lxiṛ i d-ccetkan, ad ɛuṣan ad xedmen yid-sen.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: Lɣaci-nni i d-ițwalin d iɛeǧǧan, ṭṭmeɛ n tudrin ad ɛuṣan ad xedmen yid-sen s lxuf.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: Lɣaci yesɛan azal, yesseɣli-d lexbaṛ-agi, ț-țaǧǧaǧat n wid yezmer a d-yesɛu tudert n mkul yiwen.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: Ur yezmir ara ad ițțuɛaqben seg wayen yeɛnan leɛtab n dayem.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: Ɣas akken ur tețțili ara lmeḥnat-agi, yella kan aṭas i gzemren ad immet.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: M'ara yemmut, m'ara d-yefk lmut, lmut-nni yesɛan tazmert iwakken ad ɛeddin lɛib-nsen.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: Yal mazal i tewwet-eț, tella di tazwara aț-țesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ-agi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Lɣaci-nni i ɣ-d-ițwaɛeǧben, țwaɣeḍsen ɣef wuḍaṛ, d leḥzen akk-d leḥzen, ur izmir a t-id-islusun leslaḥ ɣef ddemma n leɛtab i d-yețțawin.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: Aṭas-agi yețțawi-d Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen iwakken a d-yawi ṣṣbeṛ d leḥmala.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: Di waman, zemren ad ṛuḥen, ad ẓren d ayen yelhan, ad ssiwḍen s leɛtab.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Times d times ur țmețțat ara, ula d yiwen n tmes ara d-yefk lmut ur nesɛi lmut.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: Lqebṭan n leḥṛam sɛan lǧețțat sɛan tazmert, lameɛna m'ara ɛeddan s lǧețțat-nsen.

power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Xedmet lxiṛ iwakken aț-țesɛum iɛdawen di tejmaɛt tameqqrant iwakken ur kkun-iḍuṛṛen ara di kra n lweqt. Ur xedmen ara lqima n imeqqranen neɣ iberdanen.

power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Ɣef ddemma n tmes i d-yețțaken times.

power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: Axaṭer win yesɛan lḥal a d-yefk ṭṭmeɛ iɛebbayen iwakken a ten-iḍuɛen iɛdawen i qṛib a ten-iḍuɛen.
